sloka: इति तं बहु सन्दिश्य मनुः पुत्रं समाधिना ।जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टो ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम् ।। ७.७९.११ ॥
transliteration: iti taṁ bahu sandiśya manuḥ putraṁ samādhinā ।jagāma tridivaṁ hṛṣṭo brahmalokaṁ sanātanam ।। 7.79.11 ॥

translations.english: Having thus given many instructions to his son with a composed mind, Manu, delighted, went to the eternal world of Brahma, which is heaven.
